role: Drive one bounded implementation through workspace selection, scoped specialists, evidence, review reconciliation, and authorized closure.
notes: Clear requests enter directly. Every child inherits the task, exact worktree/candidate, dirty ownership, and authority, then returns to Ship. Delegation and finish actions are conditional, never automatic.

children.note: Conditional sequence, not a mandatory chain: 1-tdd runs only for one settled deterministic behavior with an independent oracle; 1-dev-test owns the project mutable feedback loop and hands a frozen candidate to pre-merge; review and commits have their own gates.
Superpowers harvest: plan execution path; Git isolation/finish remain cross-links
Independent multi-domain parallel agents; dual soft under Diagnose

Lean repository style, bounded Go-specific practice, code-synced canonical docs, an optional measurable quality contract, and bounded failure behavior that return to this build; F-C1 vs 1-clean-craftsmanship (Architecture)
Public-contract, internal-module, and old-path lifecycle specialists; inherit Ship scope/workspace/authority and return the agreed design or phase evidence

Four distinct Supabase operations: one product integration, one measured Postgres concern, one new locally verified schema concept, or rewrite of versions backed by complete observed provenance or exact human attestation; all inherit exact worktree/local-stack/authority and return without remote application

Explicit opt-in implementation checklist: surface load-bearing assumptions, choose the smallest adequate design, keep scope surgical, define falsifying evidence, then return the unchanged Ship candidate/workspace/authority

Four explicit one-candidate operations: public API contract docs, one internal why comment, one requested execution-flow block, or behavior-independent declaration order; each inherits exact worktree/revision/authority and returns without behavior changes or automatic review

Conditional workspace isolation, conflict handling, requested integration options, PR summary, and one bounded read-only research answer; persistence is explicit and each preserves and returns Ship provenance

Conditional delivery, UI, and performance specialists preserve the exact Ship candidate/worktree/authority: CI/CD owns one workflow/check contract, observability one telemetry contract, shipping one immutable release candidate, frontend engineering one bounded interaction surface, UI Styling one presentation-only visual delta with protected behavior, and performance one measured experiment. Each returns without unapproved remote execution, hosted changes, redesign, publication, or shared load.

forks.question: Is the request already buildable, or does it need specification/ticket decomposition?
forks.recommended: Direct implementation for a clear bounded request
branches: 1-to-spec → 1-to-tickets for materially unresolved or multi-session work
direct 0-implement for a clear bounded request

forks.question: Execute directly or use explicitly authorized delegation?
forks.recommended: Direct execution unless delegation was requested and has safe ownership boundaries

forks.question: Does this slice have a settled seam, deterministic behavior, independent oracle, and edit authority for a red-green loop?
forks.recommended: Use TDD only when all fit conditions are established
branches: characterization or 0-diagnosing-bugs when the current behavior/root cause is unknown
1-write-plan or 1-prototype when the contract or interface is unsettled
1-agent-evaluation for probabilistic model or RAG behavior

forks.question: Does the actual candidate have enough evidence to enter review reconciliation?
forks.recommended: Review only after applicable claims have current evidence or labeled gaps
branches: 1-code-review → fix verified in-scope findings → reverify/re-review → 1-atomic-git-commits when authorized
continue the current slice or next requested ticket

forks.question: Which optional verification outcome is required?
forks.recommended: Infer from the requested outcome; ask only for material ambiguity
